summary: TaoWeave, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on October 7, 2026, disclosing via press release that portfolio company Manako Labs Ltd. has gone live commercially with Avia Thévenin-Ducrot, a French fuel retail group. Manako's Vision Agents now operate around the clock across a first wave of 124 unmanned Avia Xpress stations, and Avia named Manako its lead Physical AI design partner. TaoWeave holds North American commercialization rights. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics were disclosed; the filing is an ordinary business-update current report, not a special situation.
